# Watchlist brief: 2026-10-28

## Market backdrop

The S&P 500 rose 0.75% (z-score 0.8). Strongest sector: Materials (XLB) +1.81%; weakest: Communication Services (XLC) -0.21%.

## Notable moves

### AAPL: +6.16% (z-score 2.99, volume 3.6x normal)
- **What happened:** AAPL moved +6.16% on volume 3.6x normal.
- **Vs. sector and market:** AAPL rose 6.16%; its sector (Technology, XLK) rose 0.48% and the S&P 500 rose 0.75%. That is 5.68 points better than its sector, an unusual gap for AAPL (z-score 3.8), so the move looks specific to AAPL.
- **Likely why:** Quarterly results beat expectations and guidance was raised. [Demo Markets Daily](https://news.example.com/2026-10-28/aapl-earnings)
- **Worth watching:** whether the move holds into the next session.

## Quiet
